description: Verify an x402 seller before you pay it. Sends one unpaid request to the endpoint, reads its payment request (HTTP 402), and returns one verdict (ok, caution or avoid) with a 0-100 risk score and plain reasons: who gets paid, in which asset and network, the price, and whether the payee is on the OFAC sanctions list or a scam blacklist. Flags burn-address payees, look-alike or unknown tokens, testnet requests, asset and network mismatches, very high prices, plain http and mixed payees. Never pays and never signs anything. Not charged for invalid input or unreachable sellers. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

method.description: Optional: GET or POST. Default tries GET, then POST if GET is refused.

url.description: The x402 endpoint URL to check (https).

name: x402_seller_check
title: Is this x402 seller safe to pay? Reads the seller's payment request and returns ok, caution or avoid
